# Lab templates

The ready-made experiments the [policy and stress lab](../analytics/lab.md) offers, and that `template(id, years)` returns in a script. Each changes one lever (or applies one stress), so an effect has one cause. Every number in them is a stated assumption you can change before running. The arms are shown here as built for a 10-year run; a stress that lasts "the whole run" scales with the years you choose.

Limits for any experiment: at most 6 arms, 64 seeds and 40 years, and 800 province-years in all (seeds × years × runs per seed, the baseline included).

## For actuaries

### SAM life stresses on the burial society

`sam-life-stresses` · *Does the burial society survive the standard formula's life stresses, lived through rather than assumed?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Mortality +15% on every age (`mortality-15`) | SAM mortality stress +15%: mortality ×1.15 at every age, from month 0 for 120 months |
| Catastrophe: +1.5‰ of lives in one month (`catastrophe`) | SAM catastrophe month: mortality ×2.8 at every age, from month 12 for 1 month |

Leads with: Burial society reserve at the end, Burial society ruined, Claims / premiums, Deaths: actual / expected.

### A pandemic year

`pandemic-year` · *What does a year of pandemic mortality, heaviest among the old, do to deaths, the society and the economy?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Year two: ×1.25 all ages, ×1.8 at 60 and over (`pandemic`) | Pandemic: all ages ×1.25: mortality ×1.25 at every age, from month 12 for 12 months; Pandemic: 60 and over a further ×1.44: mortality ×1.44 at ages 60 to 110, from month 12 for 12 months |

Leads with: Deaths per 1,000 a year, Life expectancy at birth, Burial society reserve at the end, Claims / premiums.

### Is the funeral premium adequate?

`premium-adequacy` · *How do the society's reserve and its chance of ruin move if the premium is cut or raised by a fifth?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Premium −20% (R96) (`premium-down`) | `funeralPremium`: `96` (default `120`) |
| Premium +20% (R144) (`premium-up`) | `funeralPremium`: `144` (default `120`) |

Leads with: Burial society reserve at the end, Burial society ruined, Claims / premiums, Households with funeral cover.

### A rate shock

`rate-shock` · *What does 300 basis points on the repo rate for two years do to households, the bank and the society?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Repo +300 bp in years two and three (`repo-300`) | Rate stress +300 bp: repo +300 bp, from month 12 for 24 months |

Leads with: Household debt at the end, Household savings at the end, Unemployment (last year), Burial society reserve at the end.

## For governments

### Raise the old-age grant

`old-age-grant` · *What does a 20% higher older persons grant cost the fiscus, and what does it buy in poverty and health?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Old-age grant +20% (R2,880) (`grant-up`) | `oldAgeGrant`: `2,880` (default `2,400`) |

Leads with: Social grants a year, Households in poverty (last year), Income Gini (last year), Life expectancy at birth, Fiscal balance a year.

### Raise the child support grant

`child-grant` · *What does a child support grant of R800 cost, and how far does it move child poverty and child deaths?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Child support grant R800 (`csg-800`) | `childGrant`: `800` (default `580`) |

Leads with: Social grants a year, Households in poverty (last year), Under-five deaths per 1,000 births, Fiscal balance a year.

### Raise the minimum wage

`minimum-wage` · *Does a 15% higher national minimum wage lift incomes, or cost jobs?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Minimum wage +15% (R34.76/h) (`nmw-15`) | `minimumWageHourly`: `34.76` (default `30.23`) |

Leads with: Unemployment (last year), Households in poverty (last year), Income Gini (last year), Real GDP per resident (last year).

### An oil price shock

`oil-shock` · *What does Brent at 1.8 times its path for a year do to prices, the repo rate, fares and household budgets?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Brent ×1.8 from month six for a year (`oil-18`) | Oil shock ×1.8: Brent ×1.8, from month 6 for 12 months |

Leads with: Inflation, a year on average, Households in poverty (last year), Household debt at the end, Real GDP per resident (last year).

## For social developers

### Funeral cover for every household

`funeral-cover-for-all` · *If every household joined the burial society, does the pool hold, and what does it do to debt after a death?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Every household covered from the start (`cover-all`) | `funeralCoverShare`: `1` (default `0.75`); and the same in every settlement tier (`tiers`) |

Leads with: Households with funeral cover, Burial society reserve at the end, Burial society ruined, Household debt at the end.

### Better clinics

`better-clinics` · *What do clinics with better care (quality 0.8 instead of 0.55) do to deaths, admissions and life expectancy?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Clinic care quality 0.8 (`care-08`) | `careQuality`: `0.8` (default `0.55`) |

Leads with: Life expectancy at birth, Deaths per 1,000 a year, Hospital admissions per 1,000 a year, Under-five deaths per 1,000 births.

### Medical aid for more households

`medical-aid` · *If half of all households had medical aid, how do care-seeking, deaths and household budgets change?*

| Arm | Changes |
|---|---|
| Medical aid for half of households (`medical-50`) | `medicalAidShare`: `0.5` (default `0.3`); and the same in every settlement tier (`tiers`) |

Leads with: Life expectancy at birth, Hospital admissions per 1,000 a year, Household savings at the end, Households in poverty (last year).
